# AYMEN.DEV — DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

## About
I am Aymen ben Yedder, a DevOps Engineer and Web Systems Architect based in Medenine, Tunisia. Over the past 8 years I have designed and operated production infrastructure for food delivery platforms, safety management systems, and on-demand service applications. I specialize in CI/CD pipelines, Docker containerization, Kubernetes, GitOps (ArgoCD/FluxCD), observability (Prometheus/Grafana), and self-hosted infrastructure on VPS.

## Core Stack
- Infrastructure: Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes, NGINX, Apache, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, FluxCD, OpenTofu, Terragrunt, Terraform, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Ansible
- Development: React, Node.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, Hono, TanStack, HTML5, CSS3, WordPress
- Databases: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Qdrant
- Automation: Bash, PowerShell, GitHub Actions, CI/CD
- Project Management: Agile, Scrum, Kanban, ClickUp
